name: 智谱AI输入法
desc: Zhipu's AI keyboard for writing on mobile.
desc_zh: 智谱的 AI 输入法，面向移动端写作
solves: Mobile typing is where most writing actually happens, and that is exactly where chat assistants are not. An IME reaches you where you already type.
solves_zh: 手机上才是真正在写字的地方，而聊天助手恰恰不在那儿。输入法能到你已经在打字的地方。
best_for: You draft and edit text mostly on a phone and want AI help at the keyboard.
best_for_zh: 你主要在手机上起草和修改文字，希望 AI 在键盘边帮上忙。

revisions.why: slug 退化产物（中文名→ai + 序号），换成可读 id
